Summary

Gulf Breeze is a city in Florida, the United States. The population in Gulf Breeze was 7,067 in 2025. The median age in Gulf Breeze was 49.9 in 2024. The median income in Gulf Breeze was $48,675 in 2024. The percentage of people with obesity in Gulf Breeze was 29.1% in 2022. The percentage of people who binge drink in Gulf Breeze was 20.5% in 2022. The percentage of people who smoke in Gulf Breeze was 12.7% in 2022.

Gulf Breeze is a city in Florida, the United States. The population in Gulf Breeze was 7,067 in 2025. The median age in Gulf Breeze was 49.9 in 2024. Navarre is a city in Florida, the United States. The population in Navarre was 39,838 in 2024. The median age in Navarre was 38.8 in 2024. The median income in Navarre was $49,916 in 2024.
